slides.description: Full-screen title card: “CAPITAL SYNDICATE: FINANCIAL REALITY ENGINE.” Show a colorful top-down open-world city map with a player avatar in the center, roads, buildings, casino lights, a stock ticker, and a smartphone overlay. Around the map, use quick icon callouts: trade stocks, buy real estate, steal cars, text NPCs, commit crimes / go to jail, fish, visit a chapel, gamble. Add a small subtitle: “GTA-style freedom — with a financial-market twist.”
slides.narration: What if a finance simulator felt more like GTA? In Capital Syndicate, you live in an open world where you can trade stocks, buy property, steal cars, flirt with NPCs, commit crimes, fish, visit church, or gamble with real in-game stakes.

slides.description: A fast visual montage slide titled “THE CITY IS THE PLAYGROUND.” Divide the screen into three large panels: 1) the player driving through the city in a colorful car, with motion lines and map landmarks; 2) the Neon Dragon Casino showing blackjack cards, spinning slots, poker chips, and a luck meter; 3) the Whispering Temple Chapel / church landmark rendered prominently, with the player approaching its entrance. Add small labels: “Drive,” “Risk it,” and “Explore.”
slides.narration: The fun is physical and visual: cruise through the city, take risks in blackjack, poker, slots, or roulette-style mini-games, then explore landmarks like the Whispering Temple Chapel. It feels like a living sandbox, not a spreadsheet.

slides.description: Slide titled “THE FEED MOVES THE MARKET.” Place a smartphone Social/X feed at center, showing AI-generated posts from the player and NPCs. Draw animated arrows from posts labeled “hype,” “panic,” and “rumor” into stock and crypto price charts that visibly rise or fall. On the right, show an NPC chat window with generated replies and profile portraits, labeled “AI-generated NPC conversations.” Include a caption: “Posts → sentiment → prices → behavior.”
slides.narration: Here, AI content is part of the economy. A generated social post can create hype or panic that moves prices, while AI-generated NPCs reply, react, and remember the conversations that shape your life in the city.

slides.description: Slide titled “THE REAL WIN: BUILD $10M.” Show a bold horizontal milestone ladder with five illuminated checkpoints: “$50K → $250K → $1M → $5M → $10M.” Place the player avatar at the current checkpoint with icons for trading, businesses, property, gambling, and crime beneath the ladder. In a visually separate, smaller gold badge, show “$1B FLEX GOAL” with the label “Optional bragging rights — not the win condition.”
slides.narration: Your real objective is to build a ten-million-dollar net worth, climbing from fifty thousand through two hundred fifty thousand, one million, and five million. A billion is only an optional flex goal for players chasing bragging rights—the actual win is ten million.

slides.description: Slide titled “BUILT BY A FLEET, NOT A GENERALIST.” Show a command-center diagram: a central “Human Product Owner” connected to ten specialist agent cards arranged around it—Producer, Game Designer, World Builder, Gameplay Engineer, Art Director, Visual Polish, Technical Artist, Audio Director, Writer, and QA Tester. Each card has a tiny icon and one-line role, such as “scopes work,” “balances mechanics,” or “tests in browser.” Add a footer: “Narrow roles • verifiable outputs • coordinated delivery.”
slides.narration: The game is also the lesson: it is built by ten coordinated AI specialists, each with a narrow job, from producer and world-builder to gameplay engineer, writer, and QA tester. That agentic workflow beats asking one generalist assistant to do everything.

slides.description: Slide titled “WHAT’S NEXT.” Use a roadmap over a city-at-night background with five connected destination icons: 1) lively NPCs with speech bubbles and relationships, 2) a polished smartphone UI, 3) Social/X posts linked to live stock, crypto, and real-estate prices, 4) the Court & Prison system with “bribe or escape” choices, and 5) upgraded character and building art. End with a small callout: “Make the world feel alive.”
slides.narration: Next, we’re making the world feel more alive: richer NPC behavior, a finished smartphone interface, and social posts tied directly to stock, crypto, and real-estate prices. We’ll also expand the bribe-or-escape jail system and raise the quality of every character and building.
